title: Sign Language Recognition
subtitle: WLASL100 gloss classification from MediaPipe Holistic landmarks, 100 classes, honest train/val/test split

metrics.label: Top-5 accuracy
metrics.detail: correct gloss in the top five ranked classes

metrics.label: Macro F1
metrics.detail: unweighted mean over the classes present in the test split

sections.title: Training curve
sections.note: Validation accuracy is the honest signal: training accuracy reaches 86% by the last epoch while validation stays near 16%, which is the 100-class overfitting gap this project reports rather than hides.

sections.title: Per-gloss performance
sections.note: 90 of the 100 glosses appear in the test split and carry its 162 instances, so most of the label space is never scored at test time - that is the small-split reality of WLASL100, not a reporting choice.

sections.title: Confusion matrix (test split)
sections.note: Rows are true glosses, columns predictions. The diagonal is thin because most of the 100-class space is unseen at test time.

sections.title: Prediction explorer
sections.note: Every held-out test instance with its predicted gloss and the logit margin between the top two classes. Filter to the mistakes to see where the model goes wrong.
